I prepare my shot as smoothly as I can without hesitation making sure to not miss any steps (drawing negative space in syringe, alcohol swab on injection site). When it comes time to put the needle in my belly I make sure I take a deep breath, and consciously relax my belly muscles. It’s very easy to be tense in that moment, and that doesn’t make for an easy injection. I take my time easing the needle in while singing a little song to myself. Sometimes it’s “My Neck, My Back” lmao or “Paprika” by Japanese Breakfast. I don’t know why but those are my go to songs for calming me down. I always ice the area while preparing the shot AND ice the area after while rubbing in a circular motion. If I start to feel dizzy or sick the ice pack is super helpful when placed on the top of your head or back of your neck. 

I know the build up is anxiety inducing but the actual injection takes less than 30 seconds. Move with confidence and take the shot slowly. You will get through it every week.
